title: Paprika Chicken with Caramelised Onion
steps: Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper and 1 tsp of paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and brown the chicken 4 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same pan, cook the sliced onion until soft and golden, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and remaining paprika, stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the chicken, add a splash of water, cover and simmer 10 minutes until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon and Dill
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Squeeze half the lemon over the fillets and scatter the dill on top.
Serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

title: Fresh Tomato and Basil Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil and gently cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, season and simmer 8 minutes until saucy.
Drain the pasta and toss it in the sauce.
Tear the basil over the top and serve.

title: Egg and Carrot Fried Rice
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the carrot for 3 minutes.
Push the carrot aside, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
Add the cooked rice and break up any clumps.
Pour over the soy sauce and stir-fry 2 minutes until evenly coated and hot.
Serve immediately.

title: Rosemary Beef and Potato Stew
steps: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Brown the beef in the olive oil in a heavy pot, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and rosemary and stir for 1 minute.
Cover with water, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes and cook 25 minutes more until tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Garlicky Broccoli Saute
steps: Blanch the broccoli florets in boiling salted water for 2 minutes and drain.
Heat the olive oil and gently fry the garlic until pale gold.
Add the broccoli, season and saute 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Serve warm.

title: Spanish-Style Chicken with Onion and Garlic
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Brown the thighs in olive oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the onion and cook until soft, then stir in the garlic for 1 minute.
Add a splash of water, cover and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through.
Serve hot.

title: Sauteed Red Pepper and Onion
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the red peppers, season and saute 8 minutes until tender.
Serve as a side or filling.

title: Simple Chicken and Tomato Skillet
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden, 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce thickens.
Serve hot.

title: Chickpea and Tomato Stew
steps: Warm the olive oil and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes until broken down.
Stir in the chickpeas, season and simmer 10 minutes more.
Serve warm with bread.
